userStories.title: Initialize Next.js project with App Router
userStories.description: Set up a new Next.js 14 project with App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Configure the basic project structure.

userStories.title: Set up Prisma with SQLite database
userStories.description: Install and configure Prisma ORM with SQLite. Create initial schema with Video, ExerciseCue, TimerPreset, and WorkoutLog models.

userStories.title: Create base layout and navigation
userStories.description: Create the root layout with dark theme, navigation header with links to main sections (Videos, Timer, History). Optimize for iPad landscape view with large touch targets.

userStories.title: Set up Web Audio API for timer beeps
userStories.description: Create an audio service using Web Audio API for reliable timer beeps. Handle iOS Safari audio context restrictions (require user interaction to enable). Create distinct sounds for interval start, end, and workout complete.
